standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings adventurer and welcome to the museum!
The museum has been constructed thanks to the efforts of adventurers across Gielinor, feel free to explore this floor or one below at your leisure.

steps.player: Can you tell me about this museum?

steps.npc: This museum was built as a monument to Gielinor and contains exhibits which showcase the wonders of the world brought to light by adventurers such as yourself.
This floor was built some time ago but due to popular demand and some recent contributions the floor below has also been opened up for display.
While we no longer require any contributions we'll happily take any unwanted excess that you may have.

steps.text: If the player has no materials to turn in
If the player has materials to turn in

steps.player: Could you tell me the current progress towards finishing the museum?

steps.npc: The museum is finished! Feel free to enter if you have the time.

historical-initial-dialogue.npc: Greetings adventurer and welcome to the museum!
Feel free to explore this floor at your leisure while the floor below is under construction.

historical-initial-dialogue.player: Can you tell me about this museum?

historical-initial-dialogue.npc: This museum was built as a monument to Gielinor and contains exhibits which showcase the wonders of the world brought to light by adventurers such as yourself.
This floor was built some time ago and is not as accurate as it once was.
Now, due to popular demand, the knights of Falador have decided to expand upon the displays to ensure that it includes all discoveries which have been made in recent years.
Unfortunately we lack the man power to acquire all of the resources required to build the displays.
We'd appreciate it if you could donate any materials you find on your adventures.

steps.player: I'd be happy to help. I'll keep an eye out for any useful materials.

steps.npc: The knights of Falador appreciate your support.

options.text: I'll pass, I don't have time to help.

steps.player: I'll pass, I don't have time to help.

steps.npc: I understand, you adventurers are busy folk. If you change your mind make sure to let me know.
